title: Finite freeness on a pro-etale slice agrees with internal inverse-image freeness
statement: Let X be a scheme, T a totally disconnected commutative topological ring, P an internal module over its condensed continuous coefficient ring, and W an object of X_proet. For the encoding of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], the restriction of the encoded P to the slice over W is isomorphic to a finite free module sheaf of some rank n if and only if raw internal inverse image of P along W.hom is finite free over the raw inverse-image coefficient ring. Rank zero and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Tags 03DM and 03DO (finite locally free modules and localization); Bhatt--Scholze, Section 6.8

proof.text: Use the actual pro-etale slice equivalence and the existing module_transport construction to identify module sheaves on the slice with module sheaves on W. The continuous-function ring comparison is identity on sections. The equivalence carries the unit module to the unit, hence carries each finite free module to its counterpart.

The restriction comparison identifies the transported slice encoding with encoding of canonical internal inverse image. Fully faithful transport and continuousRingFreeIso then identify its finite free presentations in both directions.

The canonical coefficient map is invertible. Restriction of scalars along its inverse is the existing comapEquivalenceOfIsIso. Its functor preserves finite biproducts, and regularIsoOfIsIso identifies its image of the regular module with the regular module. These give a comparison for every finite rank. Apply full faithfulness and extendScalarsIsoComapInv to transport finite free presentations in both directions between canonical and raw inverse image.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousRing_slice_free_iff
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (T : Type)
    [CommRing T] [TopologicalSpace T] [IsTopologicalRing T] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace T]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj T) X))
    (W : X.ProEt) :
    (∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (((continuousRingModuleEquivalence X T).functor.obj P).over W ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u + 1} (Fin n)))) ↔
    Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} W.hom).obj
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj T) X))
      (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} W.hom).mapMod _).obj P)
